relationships.evidence_quote: Conversely, i.t. administration of AM1710 decreased spinal cord dorsal horn CCL2 IR within 2 h of administration in TRPV1(+/+) and TRPV1 (−/−).

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: However, hindpaw responses from TRPV1(−/−) mice given i.p. AM1710 revealed no change from allodynia; reversal from allodynia failed (Fig. 4 A, B).

relationships.subject: AM1710
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with AM1710 decreased GFAP IR bilaterally to levels similar to non-neuropathic controls given either vehicle or AM1710.

key_findings: Intrathecal AM1710 reversed allodynia and reduced spinal GFAP and CCL2 independent of TRPV1, whereas intraperitoneal AM1710 failed in TRPV1 knockout mice.
Intrathecal CB2R agonists AM1710 and AM1241 reduced spinal and DRG TRPV1 expression in neuropathic rats.
